integrity: Proof gives every case and witness; no externally performed independent scientific audit or computational certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to nonempty binary words whose complete internal zero-gap lengths are pairwise different. Repeated gaps permit words with many ones. The proof is infinite; exhaustive computations stop at length eighteen and supplementary seeded tests are finite. Historical equivalents may be unindexed.
title: A sharp four-marker ceiling for palindromic periodicities in gap-distinct binary words
